title: Post-training
tagline: Instruction tuning, reward models, RLHF, preference optimisation and parameter-efficient fine-tuning
summary: A pretrained model predicts text; an assistant follows instructions. This course covers supervised instruction tuning, reward modelling and reinforcement learning from human feedback, direct preference optimisation, AI feedback and constitutional methods, and the parameter-efficient methods that make fine-tuning cheap.

chapters.title: Instruction tuning
chapters.summary: Supervised fine-tuning on instructions and dialogues, chat templates and system prompts.

chapters.title: Reinforcement learning for language models
chapters.summary: Policies, rewards, policy gradients and the KL-regularised objective.

chapters.title: Reward models
chapters.summary: Learning rewards from human comparisons, the Bradley–Terry model and reward over-optimisation.

chapters.title: Reinforcement learning from human feedback
chapters.summary: The RLHF pipeline with PPO, its practical difficulties and what it changes in a model.

chapters.title: Direct preference optimisation
chapters.summary: DPO and related methods that learn from preferences without an explicit reward model.

chapters.title: AI feedback and constitutional methods
chapters.summary: Learning from model-generated feedback guided by written principles.

chapters.title: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning
chapters.summary: Adapters, prefix tuning, LoRA and QLoRA.

chapters.title: Distillation and synthetic data
chapters.summary: Training smaller models from larger ones, synthetic instruction data and model collapse.
